name: notes
description: Learning Notes System — NestJS API + Next.js web app

scripts.dev: dotenv -- concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @notes/api-client && npm run typecheck -w web && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
